description: This file implements a 'MotionService' class that provides methods to retrieve motion activities and pedometer data using iOS CoreMotion framework APIs. It handles device capability checks, authorization, querying motion data asynchronously, and data formatting.

classes.name: MotionService
classes.description: A final class providing motion activity and pedometer data fetching services, conforming to 'MotionServicing'. It handles device capability checks, permissions, data queries, and data transformation.

methods.name: activities
methods.description: Fetches motion activity data within a specified time range, returning structured activity entries.

methods.name: pedometer
methods.description: Fetches pedometer data within a specified time range, returning step count, distance, and floors ascended/descended.

methods.name: resolveRange
methods.description: Converts ISO8601 date strings into Date objects, defaulting to start of current day or current date if inputs are nil.

methods.name: confidenceString
methods.description: Converts CMMotionActivityConfidence enum values to corresponding string representations.
